note: White River NF (Eagle-Holy Cross RD) at the south end of Sweetwater Lake, ~7,700 ft, among scrub oak and willow under limestone cliffs; reached from Dotsero by the Colorado River Road and Sweetwater Creek Road. Ute, Cross Creek and Sweetwater Nature trails start at the campground; horse traffic is heavy, so dogs on leash. The lake is the site of the proposed Sweetwater Lake State Park. --Claude
